verdict.rationale: Skyvern's browser-sessions docs say a VNC stream lets you watch the session or take control at any point. They also describe human-in-the-loop pauses that keep browser state, and cookies, tabs and the current page persist, so a run can continue after manual intervention. Missing for 10: detailed docs on triggering takeover when the agent is stuck and handing control back to the agent, plus independent or hands-on confirmation of live VNC takeover.
